assets.visualReview: Six complete regular rounded rods are visible in exactly four separated spatial groupings: two isolated singles and two end-touching pairs. The bodies have restrained size variation, individual silver-blue boundaries, sparse long gently curved flagella, and much shorter fine pili. No appendage is body-like, and there is no dense hair mat, shared web, capsule halo, scene, label, or clipping.
